context: Asuka lectures on human nature, with literary register.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: philosophy lecture; literary forms (あろう/つつ/のみ/行為) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 人は、なぜ他者を助けるのであろうか。
lines.style: contemplative teacher voice, soft warm measured philosophical clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 優しさから、ではないでしょうか。
lines.style: soft thoughtful woman voice, gentle warm curious attentive throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 優しさのみが、理由とは限りません。
lines.en: Kindness alone isn't always the reason.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured philosophical clarity throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 迷いつつ、人は手を差し伸べます。
lines.en: While hesitating, people lend a hand.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured philosophical clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: その行為に、見返りはあるんでしょうか。
lines.en: Is there a reward for that act?
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm reflective attentive throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 見返りを求めぬ行為も、確かにあります。
lines.en: Acts that seek no reward certainly exist.
lines.style: reflective teacher voice, soft warm measured philosophical clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 全ての人に、その心があるんですね。
lines.en: So all people hold that heart.
lines.style: moved woman voice, soft warm quiet realization throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そう信じつつ、生きたいものであろう。
lines.en: We'd like to live believing so.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured gentle clarity throughout
